name: To My Dearest Witch
source:
In a devout, industrial metropolis (c. 1918–1939), the Church maintained order through fully trained witch hunters, who put their own lives to protect the populace and kept dark forces at bay, allowing the city to exist in fragile peace.

[Edited from [url=https://abdiloading.itch.io/to-my-dearest-witch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个虔诚的工业大都市（约1918年至1939年），教会通过训练有素的猎巫人维持秩序，他们用自己的生命来保护民众并阻止黑暗势力，使这座城市在脆弱的和平中存在。

[编辑自[url=https://abdiloading.itch.io/to-my-dearest-witch]itch.io[/url]]
